text:
maria (partnerships): quick sync — partners asked for a consolidated announce matrix and SKU priority list for joint marketing + marketplace tagging. can we draft today? :spiral_calendar:

aj (product): yes — we should lock embargo windows per vendor first. do we have H100/H200 target weeks from nvidia?

nvidia-bizdev: H100 target is still w36 for initial GA with limited SKUs, H200 soft launch w42 (internal), embargo window w35-w37 for partner PRs. details coming via vendor deck later today.

tanner (eng): noted. capacity-wise on our end H100-backed pools will be limited first 2 weeks. we need SKU mapping in the matrix so ops can slot nodes.

sachin (platform): pls include marketplace SKU IDs + billing alias in the matrix. if we don't have those exact IDs we should include provisional tags like "rw-infer.h100.standard.v1" so billing team can pre-provision.

amd-ecosystem: MI300 plan is shifting — partner said availability looks like mid-q4 now (w44-w46). embargo preferred w43 to give room for docs.

gaudi-partner: Gaudi cards arriving to SI labs around w40, but end-customers will see marketplace availability only after our compatibility tests (w41-w42). recommend we mark Gaudi as "beta-marketplace" in the draft.

aj (product): good call. maria — can you create a minimal matrix with columns: vendor, model, desired announce week, embargo window, marketplace SKU (prov), ops slotting notes, go/no-go criteria?

maria (partnerships): on it. I started a draft table and pasted below — will iterate based on replies. feel free to copy/edit.

```
vendor | model  | announce_week | embargo_window | marketplace_sku_prov                | ops_notes
NVIDIA  | H100   | w36           | w35-w37        | rw-infer.nvidia.h100.prov           | limited pool first 2w, canary rollout
NVIDIA  | H200   | w42           | w41-w43        | rw-infer.nvidia.h200.prov           | regional ramp after w42
AMD     | MI300  | w45           | w43-w46        | rw-infer.amd.mi300.prov             | compatibility QA required
Gaudi   | B200   | w41-beta      | w40-w42        | rw-infer.gaudi.b200.beta            | SI lab tests -> marketplace beta
```

maria (partnerships): questions for the group: 1) do we want a single public announce per vendor or staggered per model? 2) are embargo windows flexible +/-1 week?

sachin (platform): prefer staggered per model when capacity differs (e.g., H100 vs H200). embargo windows we can be +/-1 week but must be explicit in the matrix so legal/comms can sign off.

tanner (eng): ops asks for exact SKU names by next Tue so infra teams can tag images. provisional names are fine for now but flag them as provisional in the matrix.

nvidia-bizdev: we'll aim to confirm SKU names by EOD tomorrow. also, marketing wants joint customer quote slots in the press kit — can product/comms confirm acceptable customers?

aj (product): product/comms will circulate the customer consent template. if partners want joint quotes, we'll need sign-off during embargo.

gaudi-partner: flag — some Gaudi SKUs will have 8-bit quantization-only builds initially. call that out in ops_notes to avoid QA regressions.

maria (partnerships): action items I'm capturing: @aj circulate customer consent template; @nvidia-bizdev confirm SKU names EOD tomorrow; @amd-ecosystem confirm MI300 availability window by Fri; @gaudi-partner confirm quantization notes + sample SKU; @sachin work with billing to accept provisional marketplace tags. i'll post updated matrix by EOD today and schedule a 30m sync for Mon to lock embargoes.

announce-bot: template: https://internal.redwood/announce-templates/joint-vendor-announce-v1 — use the "marketplace" checklist.

aj (product): +1 to Monday sync. pls include legal and comms on the invite.

maria (partnerships): will do. tagging everyone: please add any hard constraints in-thread (short bullets) so I can fold into the matrix. :thumbsup:

nvidia-bizdev: hard constraint: H100 initial press embargo cannot be earlier than w35 (partner legal).

amd-ecosystem: hard constraint: MI300 driver cert may add a 5-7 day delay post-device arrival.

gaudi-partner: hard constraint: SI compatibility test SLA is 10 business days after lab receipt.

sachin (platform): billing constraint: marketplace SKU must be provisioned at least 48 hours before public announce to avoid failed checkout flows.

tanner (eng): ops constraint: canary pool requires 50% of first-week capacity reserved for rollback testing.

maria (partnerships): perfect — i'll bake these into the go/no-go column. final ask: if anyone can't attend the Mon sync, drop your constraints here and i'll represent.

aj (product): i'll be there.

sachin (platform): may be on a deploy, will drop notes if I can't make it.

maria (partnerships): thanks folks — updating now. posting updated file in #drive and pinging calendar invite in 10m. :raised_hands:
